author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새 수만 마리 · 텃새 수백 마리
summary: 드물게 사는 텃새이면서 흔한 겨울철새로, 우리나라 논병아리류 가운데 가장 크다. 강 하구와 호수, 저수지, 해안에서 잠수해 물고기 등을 잡으며, 겨울에는 해안에서 수백 마리씩 무리를 짓기도 한다. 번식기에는 물풀이나 이끼로 물에 뜨는 둥지를 짓고 자리를 비울 때는 알을 풀로 덮어 두며, 새끼는 깨어난 뒤 어미를 따라다니다 때로 어미 등에 올라타 옮겨 다닌다. 유라시아 대륙 중부, 아프리카, 오스트레일리아, 뉴질랜드에 분포하며, 유라시아에서 번식하는 무리는 겨울에 남쪽으로 내려가 월동한다.

art.subject: Great Crested Grebe (Podiceps cristatus), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean reservoirs in early summer: crown and double crest black; face and throat white; a broad ruff of chestnut-orange plumes on the sides of the head, tipped black at the lower edge, framing the white face; a dark line from the eye to the bill; foreneck and breast white; hindneck and back dark grey-brown; flanks tinged rufous-brown. Long, dagger-shaped bill dusky pink with a darker culmen; red eye; legs set at the very rear and hidden under water.
art.pose: swimming with a chick riding on its back
art.scene: Korean reservoir in early summer (June) with floating water plants and fresh green reeds along the shore; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage, side view swimming: long upright white neck, black double crest, chestnut-orange ruff tipped black framing the white face, dark grey-brown back, dusky pink bill

adult winter plumage (October–March), side view swimming: black cap not reaching the eye with white above the eye, short dark crest, white face and foreneck, grey-brown hindneck and back, dusky pink bill, no ruff
art.build: Large grebe, about 49cm, the largest in Korea, with a body smaller than a Mallard's but a much longer, slender neck held upright like a column. Body sits low and flat on the water with no visible tail. Bill straight, pointed and dagger-like, a little shorter than the head. Legs set at the very rear of the body, with lobed (not webbed) toes. Dives frequently. In flight the neck and legs are stretched out, and white patches show on the forewing and secondaries.
avoid: Do not paint the ruff or long crest on winter birds; in winter only a short dark crest remains.
Do not paint webbed duck feet; grebes have lobed toes set at the rear of the body.
Do not paint a yellow bill base or a chestnut foreneck — that is Red-necked Grebe (Podiceps grisegena).
Do not paint a visible tail or a flat duck bill.
